root_cause: pickRecommendation restricted the blog channel to source-backed (external news) recommendations whenever any existed, and recommendationScore gave them +750. Keyword-driven briefs (seo_first_mover_intent_gap, with keyword, volume and CPC) were therefore never chosen. Result: the daily blog followed subsidy and cyber news (for example Circular Plastics NL, Wet DBA, cyberdreigingen) instead of search demand from the target audience.
fix: For the blog channel: no source-backed-only shortcut, +1000 plus volume/5 for seo_first_mover_intent_gap, and developer-intent keywords (api, sdk, github, developer, rest, oauth, webhook, python, php, javascript) are not eligible. LinkedIn company behaviour unchanged. News stays the fallback for the blog.
prevention_rule: The daily blog topic must come from measured search demand for the target audience; news freshness may only decide ties or serve as fallback.

invariants: keyword brief beats news brief for blog
